lines: ELDER: The Sunstone that lit our valley
was taken into the cave beyond the wood.
Thorns seal the forest path. Take the key
from the village chest, hero.
ELDER: A rune stone sleeps among the trees.
Touch it, and the cave gate will know you.
ELDER: Walk tall. The hollow believes in you.
MERCHANT: Wares for the bold! One torch,
ten coin. It is dark past the thorns.
MERCHANT: A deal well struck. Mind the drip
in the cave — it is never water.
MERCHANT: Your purse is lighter than air.
The old chest by the gate has coin.
MERCHANT: I will be here. Stone endures.
<Bramble Hollow>
North: Whispering Wood.
Do not feed the bats.
BOY: The slimes in the cave only move
when you are not looking. Probably.
GUARD: Patrol duty. Two steps right, two
back. I have memorized every pebble.
The slime bobs eagerly, as if asking
to come along. It cannot.
PORTER: Eyes front, hero. Watch my step.
PORTER: Two east, two west. Back at post.
Found 25 gold and an IRON KEY.
Its teeth are shaped like brambles.
The chest is empty. Your chest, however,
is full of purpose.
The iron key bites. The thorns part
with a sound like tearing silk.
Living thorns seal the path north.
A key shaped like brambles would open them.
SPRITE: The cave remembers every footstep.
Wake the rune stone east of here, and
its iron gate will unclench.
Moss showers off the lid. Found 15 gold.
Only moss and one disappointed spider.
You lay your palm on the stone.
A cold blue light answers, and holds.
The rune burns blue. Somewhere north,
iron is moving.
Blue light pours from the stone in your
pack. The gate folds itself open.
Bars of cold iron. Runes welded along
them wait for a light they recognize.
BLUB.
(It is, against all advice, fed.)
The bat pretends it is a stalactite.
Its commitment is impressive.
Inside waits the SUNSTONE, warm as a
small sunrise. Light returns to the hollow.
The altar breathes slow, satisfied.
THE END.
You carried the Sunstone home.
Bramble Hollow wakes gold again.
